What is editable

  • ListingsCreate, edit, publish
  • House collectionsCopy, prices, materials
  • Smart packagesDevice lists and prices
  • Blog postsWrite and schedule
  • ProjectsProgress and photos
  • Team and FAQBios and answers
  • Page copyEnglish and Kiswahili
  • Legal documentsVersioned

Workflow

Draft → review → published. Editors cannot publish without review. Every change records who made it and when, and any version can be restored in one click.

Translations

Every field has an English and a Kiswahili value. If a translation is missing the site falls back to English rather than showing an empty space.
